description: This file contains a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods to facilitate logging in an Android project. It defines constants for log levels and methods to log messages at various levels, leveraging an internal LogNode chain for output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to log messages at various levels, using a chain of LogNode objects to handle the actual output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain where logs are directed.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain for log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the current LogNode for printing. Supports different method overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level; overloads allow inclusion of a Throwable.
